sampleStatistics: Unweighted observed samples; nearest-rank p50 and p95; not time-weighted percentiles.
fixtureDigest: SHA-256 of each sanitized fixture record in ordinal order, sorted JSON keys, compact separators, and a trailing newline per record.

postShutdownStorage.method: Sum logical lengths of regular files without following symbolic links. Page totals include distinct immutable files; repeated references do not add bytes.
